sentences.text: No, a UCB shall not levy any charges where pre-payment is effected at the instance of the bank.
This rule is stated for loans and advances sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026.
The documents do not state any exception to that no-charge rule for pre-payment at the instance of the bank.

missing.searched: UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025 para 261(7) and related pre-payment charge provisions
